title: Pseudo-differential Operators and Microlocal Analysis
abstract: Study of pseudo-differential operators in the framework of microlocal analysis: symbolic calculus, regularity properties in Sobolev spaces, and propagation of singularities via wave front set theory.

title: Structural Robustness Analysis of an SEIR-B Model for Cholera
abstract: Development and analysis of a compartmental SEIR-B model for cholera dynamics in West Africa, calculating the controlled reproduction rate with sensitivity analysis.

title: Multi-strain Epidemic Model with Non-local Dispersion
abstract: Rigorous mathematical analysis of an SIS model with non-local dispersion governed by integro-differential equations. Numerical exploration reveals spatial coexistence phenomena via niche segregation.

title: Nonparametric Kruskal-Wallis Test Implementation
abstract: Comparative implementation and performance analysis of the nonparametric Kruskal-Wallis test across MATLAB, R, and Python.
